root_motivation: Who: Joe and the controller reading the PMF line. What: a count of real external users they can act on. Why not today: origin='external' was the default for anything not provably synthetic, so unstamped fleet scripts on a public IP were counted as users (16 prod signups, 2026-10-20).
user_persona: Joe reading status sees external (claimed, returned), unattributed and synthetic counts and knows which number is a user; the chain's traffic gate reads tenants_real as external-with-evidence only.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given a signup from a non-loopback, non-fleet IP with no X-Mcphost-Synthetic header, When the tenant row is written, Then origin is unattributed with detail no-positive-evidence and healthz tenants_by_origin.unattributed rises by one.

Given an unattributed tenant, When its claim e-mail is verified, Then origin is external with detail claimed-email and exactly one admin_audit origin_promoted row exists even when promotions race (single-row UPDATE WHERE origin='unattributed').

Given an unattributed tenant with no fleet-IP or header-stamped call in its history, When a clean authenticated call arrives on a later UTC date and at least 21,600 s after creation, Then origin is external with detail returned:<n>d and the audit row carries the IP hash; a 15 s cross-midnight call, a fleet-IP call or a header-stamped call never promotes.

Given a synthetic tenant, When a claim is verified or a qualifying later-day call arrives, Then origin stays synthetic, no origin_promoted row is written, and synthetic_promotion_refused increments and is readable in healthz.

Given one seeded tenant per case (external+verified, external+later-day only, external+same-day only, unclassified, synthetic+verified), When the migration runs, Then verified is external/claimed-email, unverified externals are unattributed/legacy-external-unverified, unclassified is unattributed/legacy-unclassified, synthetic is unchanged, no row is NULL, and journaled before and after totals match.

Given an empty DB and a seeded DB, When healthz, mcphost funnel --json, admin funnel and scripts/ops/origin-counts.py are read, Then all report identical keys (all 0 when empty), tenants_real equals external, tenants_confirmed equals claimed, origin_unknown is 0, and the script equals healthz.

Given the single Origin enum, When the generated-contract test runs, Then the value list, healthz keys and funnel keys derive from Origin::as_str at compile time and the test fails if a surface lists a value the enum lacks or lacks one it has, while the migration SQL stays a static string.

Given prod after deploy, When the operator runs scripts/ops/origin-counts.py on mcphost-1 as a counts-only ro read, Then it prints the counts with n == a + b and the totals match the pre-deploy tenant count (Live; deferred, operator-provisioned).
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred -- operator-provisioned: script run on mcphost-1, pasted into the run note.

scope: src/state.rs: the Origin enum (synthetic, internal, unattributed, external), tri-state derive_origin.
src/db.rs: promote_origin, observe_origin_call, origin_report, migration 0132 gate; src/handler.rs: observe_origin_evidence on the authenticated call path.
non_goals: Offboarding or deleting any tenant; changing what counts as synthetic; a UI; rotating keys; changing signup rate limits; deciding whether returned counts toward PMF.

additional.no_schema_rebuild: No CHECK constraint and no DEFAULT change on origin: both force SQLite table rebuilds of tenants, signup_events and calls.

five_whys_trace.q: Why did fleet scripts count as real users?
five_whys_trace.a: They sent no synthetic header from an IP outside MCPHOST_FLEET_IPS.
classify_source_class returned External by elimination and derive_origin wrote external for every non-synthetic row.
The allowlist of what is ours was assumed complete; fleet hosts move networks and scripts appear faster than the list.

five_whys_trace.q: Why was no positive signal used?
five_whys_trace.a: owner_verified_at and later-day calls were stored but origin never read them; external now requires one.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What detail does a return promotion carry?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: returned:<n>d (the requirements text), n = whole UTC days between created_unix and the call; the audit detail also carries ip_hash.
